description: Planned discontinuation of a service is notified a set period in advance, or the service continues to the end of the committed term.
source_document: Legal Constitution, Lawyer Review Version L1.10 — docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.10.md
source_quote: Provide 30 days' advance notice, OR continue the service until the customer's committed contract period ends, whichever is later ... CONFIRMED.

evaluation_rules._note: comparison semantics live in tested code (44.29)

_calibration: The compound position ('30 days OR the end of the committed period, whichever is later') has two limbs; this standard measures the notice limb only and the 'whichever is later' wording would be a COMPOSITE the extractor refuses to reduce (AM-54 r2) → a person.
